_meta.description: Hand-set buzz tiers (1-5) + one-line reasons that drive pre-season fantasy prices via scripts/lib/fantasy-pricing.js. Edit tiers here, then re-run `node scripts/generate-fantasy-config.js --refreeze` BEFORE the draft opens. After the draft opens prices are frozen (data/fantasy-league-frozen.json) and this file only prices shows announced later (append-only). Per-show keys: tier (awards + reviews expectation), boxOfficeTier (optional, when the box-office outlook differs), runWeeks (optional, assumed run length when no closing date is announced), awardsEligible:false (special events, solo shows, holiday spectaculars), exclude:true (never draftable).

tierGuide.5: Best Musical/Play/Revival frontrunner with strong box office expectations
tierGuide.4: Likely top-category nominee or a major box-office draw
tierGuide.2: Long shot for awards, modest grosses
tierGuide.1: Closed early, special event, or very unlikely to earn awards points

weeklyGrossPriors._note: Median weekly gross over each show's first 20 reporting weeks, 2025-26 Broadway season (data/grosses-history.json, computed 2026-09-29). Multiplied by the tier's gross multiplier and capped by the house (seats x 8 x $150 x 95%).

_meta.sources: Research pass 2026-09-29: Gold Derby early-2027 previews, Playbill, Deadline, Variety, NYTG, TDF fall preview, Broadway League opening-night calendar, Broadway Scorecard scores for prior productions.

paranormal-activity-2026.note: Opened Aug 25 to Recommended-range reviews (78) and sells out the August Wilson; its awards path is the design categories (sound, lighting, scenic), not Best Play. Closes Jan 3.

school-girls-or-the-african-mean-girls-p.note: MTC's revival of Jocelyn Bioh's comedy opened Sept 28 to strong reviews (82); Denée Benton and Patina Miller are the acting-nom hopes, but the run ends Nov 1 so almost no grosses are left.

celebrity-autobiography-2026.note: Five-week return engagement at the Shubert that closed in June with mixed reviews (68); a pure awards long shot.

other-desert-cities-2026.note: Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Ed Harris, Allison Janney, Joe Keery and Lily Rabe in Jon Robin Baitz's Pulitzer finalist; the starriest play of the fall and a Best Revival favorite. 16 weeks, closes Jan 17.

billy-crystal-860-2026.note: Billy Crystal's solo show at the Imperial, directed by Scott Ellis: a near-certain sellout, but solo shows are not Best Play contenders. 14 weeks, closes Jan 2.

the-imaginary-invalid-2026.note: Bill Irwin adapts and stars in Roundabout's Molière, with Rachel Bloom's Broadway debut; closes Nov 22, five months before nominations.

a-few-good-men-2026.note: Bradley Whitford and Tom Blyth in the first Broadway revival of Aaron Sorkin's courtroom drama, directed by Michael Arden at Lincoln Center's Beaumont. 13 weeks, closes Jan 10.

wanted-2022.note: New musical (formerly Gun & Powder, whose Signature and Paper Mill runs scored 83 and 86) with Solea Pfeiffer and Ledisi; Gold Derby calls it the homegrown show that could challenge Paddington. Open run.

here-there-are-blueberries-2026.note: Tectonic Theater Project's Pulitzer-finalist docudrama, a Lortel winner Off-Broadway; its London run scored 72. Ten-week run at the Barrymore through Jan 10.

now-you-see-me-live-2026.note: Holiday magic spectacle spun off the film franchise; the London run scored 72. Box office only, eight weeks through Jan 3.

downstate-2026.note: Bruce Norris's NY Drama Critics' Circle Best Play winner, directed by Joe Mantello with K. Todd Freeman and Francis Guinan; the best-reviewed play text of the fall. 12 weeks, closes Jan 10.

the-fantasticks-2026.note: First Broadway production of the world's longest-running musical, reimagined by Christopher Gattelli at the 597-seat Hayes with Ruthie Ann Miles; a thin revival field is its main path. Closes Feb 7.

blue-man-group-a-new-holiday-surprise-20.note: Holiday special at the Lunt-Fontanne; box office only, closes Jan 3.

much-ado-about-nothing-2026.note: Tom Hiddleston and Hayley Atwell in Jamie Lloyd's Olivier-nominated Drury Lane production, already close to sold out at the Winter Garden. Strictly 10 weeks, closes Jan 10.

inter-alia-2026.note: Rosamund Pike's Olivier-winning Broadway debut in Suzie Miller's follow-up to Prima Facie; the National Theatre run scored 83 with raves for the performance and doubts about the script. Closes Feb 21.

galileo-2026.note: Raúl Esparza's first Broadway musical since 2012, directed by Michael Mayer at the Shubert; the Berkeley Rep tryout scored 60. Open run.

awake-and-sing-2026.note: Danny Burstein, Jessica Hecht and Micaela Diamond in MTC's Odets revival; a strong cast, but an eight-week engagement ending Feb 7 in a crowded revival year.

dolly-an-original-musical-2026.note: Dolly Parton's autobiographical musical, directed by Bartlett Sher; the Nashville tryout scored 83 and Parton will sell the St. James. Awards upside is capped by the bio-jukebox format.

mix-and-master-2027.note: World premiere from Dominique Morisseau with Kara Young and Ruben Santiago-Hudson, directed by Kamilah Forbes at Roundabout; eight weeks, closes Feb 28.

small-mouth-sounds-2027.note: Julia Roberts, Paul Rudd, Sarah Paulson, Martin Freeman and Greta Lee in Bess Wohl's silent-retreat comedy, directed by Joe Mantello: the season's biggest star package.

evita-2026.note: Rachel Zegler's Olivier-winning turn in Jamie Lloyd's Palladium production (scored 82 in London) transfers to the Winter Garden; the consensus Best Revival of a Musical frontrunner.

gloria-2026.note: Branden Jacobs-Jenkins's Pulitzer-finalist office thriller at the Hayes, directed by Evan Cabnet; no cast announced yet.

purple-rain-2026.note: Prince's film on stage at the Majestic after a mixed Minneapolis tryout; a new director (Saheem Ali) and book writer came aboard for Broadway. The catalog guarantees grosses.

the-sound-of-music-2027.note: Lincoln Center Theater revival directed by Lear deBessonet with Jasmine Amy Rogers as Maria; LCT's Rodgers & Hammerstein revivals have won Best Revival before. Runs through July.

paddington-the-musical-2026.note: Seven Olivier wins including Best New Musical; the Savoy production scored 89 in London and Gold Derby calls it the de facto Best Musical frontrunner. Open run at the Hirschfeld.

damn-yankees-2027.note: Neil Patrick Harris and Julianne Hough in Sergio Trujillo's rewritten revival, which swept the Helen Hayes Awards at Arena Stage. Open run at the Marquis.

the-full-monty-2027.note: Roundabout's revival of the Yazbek and McNally musical opens on the eligibility cutoff day with no cast announced; limited run through June 20.

imitation-of-life-off-broadway-2026.note: Lynn Nottage and John Legend's new musical at The Shed with Adrienne Warren and Jessica Vosk, directed by Whitney White; the Off-Broadway musical to beat.

seven-guitars-off-broadway-2026.note: August Wilson at Lincoln Center's Newhouse, directed by Ruben Santiago-Hudson with John Douglas Thompson and Russell Hornsby.

the-curious-case-of-benjamin-button-off-.note: The Olivier-winning London musical lands at the Public.

msblackforpresident-off-broadway-2026.note: Tarell Alvin McCraney and Tina Landau's new play at the Vineyard with Wayne Brady.

the-heart-off-broadway-2026.note: New musical at Roundabout directed by Christopher Ashley with Joaquina Kalukango.

the-visitors-off-broadway-2026.note: Bryna Turner world premiere at Second Stage with Celia Keenan-Bolger.

king-of-the-yees-off-broadway-2026.note: Lauren Yee's comedy at Signature with Kelly Marie Tran and Francis Jue.

clifford-odets-waiting-for-lefty-off-bro.note: Classic Stage revival directed by Steven Pasquale with Conrad Ricamora.

the-ripple-the-wave-that-carried-me-home.note: Christina Anderson's play at Playwrights Horizons with Crystal Lucas-Perry.

spring-awakening-off-broadway-2026.note: Commercial revival at Studio Seaview opening in December.

good-time-charlie-off-broadway-2026.note: New play at the Public's Martinson Hall.

sea-wall-off-broadway-2026.note: Simon Stephens's monologue at Studio Seaview.

anon-a-tempest-at-our-kitchen-table-off-.note: Anne Washburn at MCC, directed by Anne Kauffman, with Jeremy Shamos.

the-unbelievers-off-broadway-2026.note: Nick Payne's American premiere at MTC with Lauren Ambrose and Tom Riley.

in-the-heights-off-broadway-2026.note: Encores! concert staging at City Center; not awards-eligible.

kramerfauci-st-anns-off-broadway-2026.note: Daniel Fish (Oklahoma!) stages the 1993 Larry Kramer and Anthony Fauci confrontation at St. Ann's Warehouse with Will Brill and Thomas Jay Ryan.

creation-stories-and-all-the-important-i.note: New play at LCT3's Claire Tow Theater.

slam-frank-off-broadway-2026.note: Commercial musical parody at the Orpheum.

miles-for-mary-off-broadway-2026.note: The Mad Ones' comedy returns at the Signature Center in February.

the-kings-critique-off-broadway-2026.note: New musical at the Signature Center.

the-good-thief-off-broadway-2026.note: Conor McPherson monologue at Irish Rep.

the-verge-off-broadway-2026.note: Revival at the Public's LuEsther Hall.

i-became-we-off-broadway-2026.note: New play at Atlantic Theater Company.

la-distance-bam-off-broadway-2026.note: Tiago Rodrigues at BAM's Harvey Theater.

byTitle._note: Shows announced for 2026-27 that are not in shows.json yet. Keyed by normalized title (lowercase, letters and digits only); the generator uses these when the show id is unknown at freeze time, so a mid-season addition is priced at the right tier instead of the default.

warriors.note: Lin-Manuel Miranda and Eisa Davis's new musical, produced by Kail and Seller with Andy Blankenbuehler choreographing; a Best Musical contender the moment it is dated (April 2027, Lunt-Fontanne).

threedaysofrain.note: David Corenswet, Yvonne Strahovski and François Arnaud in the Richard Greenberg revival directed by Anna D. Shapiro; previews February 2027.

catonahottinroof.note: Sam Gold directs Tennessee Williams for Seaview in spring 2027; cast to be announced.

montauk.note: Laura Linney in David Hare's world premiere at MTC's Friedman, directed by Daniel Sullivan, spring 2027.

wildrose.note: John Tiffany directs Nicole Taylor's musical at New York Theatre Workshop with Madeline Brewer.

aviewfromthebridge.note: Sam Rockwell, Marin Ireland and Alfred Molina at La MaMa, directed by Neil Pepe.

oldactress.note: Lucas Hnath, Les Waters and Deirdre O'Connell reunite at Atlantic in March 2027.

borninthedirt.note: Kimberly Belflower and Danya Taymor, the John Proctor Is the Villain team, at Lincoln Center's Newhouse in April 2027.

welcometable.note: James Ijames's new play about the Baldwin and RFK meeting, directed by Rachel Chavkin at the Public, winter 2027.

playingburton.note: Matthew Rhys as Richard Burton at Lincoln Center's Newhouse, directed by Bartlett Sher.
